title: Can I BEAT a 2000 ELO with 1 Pawn?
summary: Super Normal Chess vs the YouTuber Croissant: iwantcheckmate has a king and one h-pawn against the full army, plus three secret cheats: an Among Us intern who runs across the board and steals an enemy piece, deleting empty squares (sliders stop at the hole, knights jump over), and spawning one new pawn (insurance policy). Wins with Qe8# at 9:13.
rules: White: king + h-pawn (h4 first move). Black (Croissant): full army.
Cheat 1: the intern steals any enemy non-king piece (used ~6 times, sometimes twice in a row).
Cheat 2: delete an empty square; sliding pieces stop at it, knights jump over it (3:08).
Otherwise standard chess; checkmate wins (9:13 Qe8#).
The video combines up to two cheats before one move (5:12 steal + delete f2, 6:51 delete e3 + steal g7, 7:42 delete g7 + push): the remake allows 2 per turn.
